title: A Measurement of the Black Hole Mass in NGC 1097 Using ALMA
question: What is the SMBH mass of NGC 1097 from dense molecular gas (HCN and HCO+ J=1-0) kinematics measured with ALMA?

evidence.quote: The major axis defined here is at a position angle of $130^{\circ}$ from (cite: 1991rc3..book.....D).

recipe.goal: Image the HCN and HCO+ cubes and make moment maps
recipe.method: CASA imaging with robust 0.5, 2-channel binning; moment maps with Karma
Fit multi-Gaussian expansion to HST F814W major-axis profile after subtracting AGN (PSF 0.2'') and masking starburst ring
assumptions: Axisymmetric galaxy; constant I-band M/L radially

recipe.goal: Compute circular velocity field and model PVD
recipe.method: MGE_circular_velocity at i=46 deg, then KinMS thin axisymmetric disk convolved with beam, PA 130 deg

recipe.goal: Chi-square grid fit of M_BH and M/L to PVD
recipe.method: Extract 106 points from observed PVD above 3 sigma ~8 mJy; grid M/L 4.80-5.35 (0.01), M_BH 0.5-2.5e8 (0.1e8); errors at Delta chi2<=9
key_parameters: kinematic PA 130±5 deg; velocity error = channel width 3.284 km/s plus Gaussian fit error

evidence.quote: the SMBH mass is thus estimated to be $1.40^{+0.27}_{-0.32} \times 10^{8} M_{\odot}$
The M/L ratio is estimated to be $5.14^{+0.03}_{-0.04}$
The smallest chi-square value of 113 (reduced chi-square value is 1.09 when divided with the degree of freedom)
estimate the SMBH mass to be $(1.40 \pm 0.30) \times 10^{8} M_{\odot}$
evaluate the SMBH mass to be $1.20^{+0.35}_{-0.34} \times 10^{8} M_{\odot}$

not_stated_but_needed: Calibration details (calibrators, flux scale, pipeline vs manual)
Image size and cell size, cleaning threshold, masking
KinMS parameters: gas disk radial profile, thickness, number of clouds
Details of MGE fit and HST image processing
score_reason: Public data and a clear chi-square grid, but KinMS and calibration settings are unspecified.
rediscovery_reason: Public Cycle 0 data, a numeric answer (M_BH, M/L), and a mostly described recipe.
